name: Tai video Youtube (batch link -> MP4/MP3 + thumbnail)
description: Dan nhieu link Youtube (moi dong 1 link). Chon chat luong (Best/2160p/1440p/1080p/720p/480p/360p) va dinh dang (MP4 hoac MP3). Ten file output = tieu de video. Tai kem thumbnail .jpg cung ten. Khong re-encode: MP4 chi doi container (remux). Loai bo AV1 o moi muc chat luong vi ffmpeg bundled (2018) khong mux duoc AV1 vao MP4; voi 1440p/2160p file MP4 co the chua VP9 thay vi H.264 - mot so player cu co the khong mo duoc. File da co san trong Output se duoc bo qua. Tu 2026-08 Youtube chan moi duong tai khong giai duoc 'n challenge' bang JavaScript; app di kem san bin/qjs.exe (QuickJS, ~2 MB) nen KHONG can cai them gi - xem ghi chu o player_client va js_runtimes ben duoi.
_comment_player_client: ADR-018 (2026-08-27, thay ADR-011). 'web_embedded' (dat tu 2026-08-18) nay da hong: kiem chung truc tiep tren nhieu video, client nay chi con tra ve format 'storyboard' (mhtml), khong con format video/audio nao - tren CA hai ban yt-dlp (2026.06.09 lan 2026.08.19), nen khong phai do ban yt-dlp cu. Doi ve rong ('') de yt-dlp TU CHON client (hanh vi mac dinh cua no) - da kiem chung tai duoc that (MP4 co tieng, MP4_NOAUDIO khong tieng, MP3) tren ban yt-dlp 2026.08.19 ma KHONG can --js-runtimes. Neu Youtube lai doi client mac dinh cua yt-dlp sang thu bi chan, uu tien CAP NHAT yt-dlp truoc (nut 'Cap nhat yt-dlp' trong app) roi moi thu ep client cu the vao day.
_comment_metadata_player_client: ADR-013. Client RIENG cho pha lay tieu de, tach khoi pha tai. Ly do: hai client hong o hai cho khac nhau - android_vr lay tieu de duoc nhung tai bi 403; web_embedded tai duoc nhung lay tieu de thi bi 'Sign in to confirm you're not a bot' khi batch nhieu link (moi link 1 lan goi, batch 20 link la 20 lan lien tiep). Ghep ca hai viec vao mot client thi cho nao cung dinh mot nua. De trong ('') se dung luon player_client.
_comment_js_runtimes: ADR-012. BAT BUOC di kem player_client=web_embedded: client do phai giai 'n challenge' bang JavaScript. Thieu runtime thi 0 format video ('Only images are available'). Gia tri 'quickjs' dung bin/qjs.exe DI KEM APP - nguoi dung KHONG can cai gi. Code tu ghep duong dan tuyet doi (bin/ khong nam tren PATH nen chi ghi ten thoi la khong du). Cac gia tri khac: 'node' hoac 'deno' neu may da cai san runtime do; hoac ghi ro duong dan dang 'node:D:\duong\dan\node.exe'. De trong ('') se tat co - khi do KHONG tai duoc gi.
_comment_format_sort: Thu tu xep hang format SAU khi da loc bang -f (yt-dlp --format-sort). Mac dinh 'res,fps,vcodec:h264' = do phan giai truoc, roi so khung hinh, roi uu tien H.264. Ly do: Premiere va nhieu NLE cu KHONG doc duoc VP9 nam trong vo MP4 - file .mp4 hoan toan hop le nhung bao 'loi dinh dang'. Do that 2026-08-25 tren video fITHDrND8tE (co ca avc1 lan vp9 o 360p): khong co co nay thi yt-dlp lay vp9, co thi lay avc1, do phan giai khong doi. Da kiem tren video 4K (UWgM09MV9zY): van giu 2160p, KHONG bi tut xuong 1080p. DANH DOI da biet: dat vcodec truoc hdr nen video HDR se lay VP9 thuong thay vi VP9.2 HDR10 o muc 4K (noi khong co avc1 nen uu tien khong giup gi). Muon uu tien HDR hon tuong thich thi doi thanh 'res,fps,hdr:12,vcodec:h264' - nhung khi do o 1080p tren video HDR no se lay lai VP9.2 chu khong lay avc1, tuc mat tac dung bao ve. Khong co chuoi nao dat ca hai (da do 5 bien the). De trong ('') = khong truyen -S = hanh vi y het truoc khi co truong nay.
_comment_concurrent_fragments: Tang tu 4 len 8 (2026-08-27) de thu toc do tren mang nhanh: Youtube (googlevideo) thuong gioi han toc do MOI ket noi HTTP rieng le, nhieu ket noi song song co the vuot qua gioi han do. Test tren mang cua nguoi viet khong thay khac biet ro (~5-6MiB/s ca hai muc, da gan bao hoa duong truyen luc test) nhung tren mang nhanh hon co the co ich. Chi co tac dung khi KHONG bat 'Chi tai mot doan' - xem _comment_http_chunk_size.
_comment_http_chunk_size: Chi co tac dung khi KHONG cat doan (tai tron video): ep yt-dlp tai file thanh cac doan kich thuoc nay roi tai song song (so doan dong thoi = concurrent_fragments) thay vi mot luong HTTP duy nhat - tang toc do that su tren mang nhanh. Khi co cat doan, ffmpeg tu tai qua HTTP range nen co nay bi bo qua (khong co cach tang song song trong kien truc hien tai).
